# Agent Hands — Focus Relay

Agent Hands is a reference implementation of Focus Relay: a human focuses an object with keyboard, switch, eye-gaze, or pointer input; WebMCP reads that shared page context and performs the difficult manipulation as one atomic, reversible intent. A keyboard-operable Kanban workspace makes the handoff immediately visible.

## Key links

- [Live application](https://webmcp-board.vercel.app/)
- [Source code and complete documentation](https://github.com/charlie-troy/webmcp-board)
- [OpenAI WebMCP Challenge](https://openai.com/webmcp-challenge/)

## Agent capabilities

The page registers 12 tools. `get_current_card` reads the human's Focus Relay target. `update_current_card` atomically moves, edits, assigns, prioritizes, and dates that target in one call; prefer it when the user says "this", "current", or requests multiple changes. The remaining tools summarize and search the board; create, move, edit, assign, prioritize, date, and delete named cards; and safely undo agent work.

One `update_current_card` call creates one history entry, so one Undo restores the complete human instruction. Human changes take precedence: undo refuses to restore an older snapshot when a person made a newer board change.
